neighbours.label: a word about to name a recurring calendar period: an ordinal before 'quarter' in a business report, or 'each' before 'month'; ordinals counting other things stay quiet
fire: Shipments rebounded in the third quarter of 2017.
Its net income doubled in the second quarter.
Analysts expect growth to slow in the fourth quarter.
The company will report results for the first quarter.
The chipmaker lost money during the third quarter.
Demand weakened in the fourth quarter of last year.
Retail sales picked up in the first quarter.
The newsletter goes out each month to subscribers.
quiet: Shipments rebounded in the northern states.
The chipmaker opened a third factory in Texas.
Analysts read the fourth chapter of the report.
The author published a second novel last year.
The runner came fourth out of ten.
Her office moved to the first floor.
She is the third daughter of the mayor.
A second witness described the crash.

notes: Output promotes quarter/quarters directly. Probes: 0.49-0.98 before 'quarter', 0.36-0.40 on 'each month'; 'third floor' and 'finished third' 0; sports periods partly fire (second half 0.48, fourth inning 0.31).
